title: Efficacy of Risankizumab across distinct PsA phenotypes identified with machine learning analytics using data from biologic DMARD-Naïve patients in two phase 3 clinical trials
summary: Unsupervised finite-mixture analysis identifies five PsA phenotypes in 1,119 phase-3-trial participants and compares risankizumab outcomes by phenotype; this is a specific post-hoc treatment-response analysis. The publisher lists 2026/12; the first version reporting this result is dated 2025-11-29.
ai_technology: An unsupervised finite-mixture model identifies psoriatic-arthritis phenotypes for post-hoc comparison of risankizumab outcomes.
